facts.fact: A standard guided tour visits auditorium and selected halls.
facts.excerpt: explore the stunning auditorium and the most interesting halls

facts.fact: The standard visit is approximately40minutes and offered inItalian,English,French,Spanish,German.
facts.excerpt: The tour lasts about 40 minutes and is available in Italian, English, French, Spanish and German.

facts.fact: Backstage is a separate bookable option depending on production schedule.
facts.excerpt: the stage will not be accessible during rehearsals, performances and technical work

facts.fact: The standard tour is described as accessible; tactile models/maps are offered.
facts.excerpt: 3D models and tactile maps are available to enhance the experience of the blind and partially blind.

title: Teatro Massimo — standard and backstage guided visits
